objective: Multi-season formula architecture discrimination without pooling seasons before validation

architecture_codes.B: shared football components with position-specific coefficients
architecture_codes.D: position + archetype coefficient layers on reusable components

hypotheses.evidence: CFB26 identical rating vectors change OVR by line position: Carter Miller 80 C -> 76 LT/80 LG/77 RG/77 RT; Nolan Rucci 80 RT -> 74 C/77 LT/75 LG/76 RG; Tyler Brown 73 LG -> 70 C/70 LT/71 RG/71 RT.
Carter Miller 80->86 C gains across STR/RBK/RBF/RBP/PBK/PBF/PBP/LBK rather than one isolated rating; CFB25 Federico Maranges 90 C has PBP93/PBF90 but RBP84/RBF83/RBK85.
OOP deltas are deterministic on fixed vectors; guard/center equivalence differs from tackle valuation.
CFB26 same-OVR C contrast: Carter Miller Pass Protector 86 and Chandler Strong Agile 86 reach the same OVR with materially different STR and run/pass profiles.

CFB26 Vertical Threat reaches 81 with RBK60 and 99 with RBK87 while Pure Blocker low cards track blocking near displayed OVR despite route-running ratings in the 50s; CFB27 Physical Route Runner examples likewise carry receiving ratings near OVR with much lower blocking.
CFB26 Pure Blocker: Ja'Kavion Nonar 68 OVR has RBK/RBF/RBP/PBK/PBF/PBP/IBL all 68 while SRR56/MRR53/DRR50; Emeka Iloh 73 has RBK/RBF/RBP73, PBF/PBP73 with SRR57/MRR56/DRR54.
Vertical Threat and Physical Route Runner tolerate low RBK relative to OVR; Pure Blocker tolerates very low route-running; Gritty Possession occupies a more balanced receiving/blocking profile.
Across archetypes, CTH/STR/physical competence co-move enough to support reusable components, but dominant component changes by archetype.
CFB26 fixed-vector OOP: Chris Davis 93 CB -> 86 FS/87 SS; Vic Beasley 99 FS -> 95 CB/97 SS; Tony Mitchell 72 SS -> 70 CB/70 FS; Javien Toviano 77 SS -> 76 CB/75 FS.

CFB25 Zone CB progression and CFB26 Box/Hybrid safety evidence show role-specific slack; Box Specialist Isaiah Nwokobia is 93 SS with MCV89/PRS85 while maintaining TAK92/POW91; same OVR can tolerate large BSH/POW variation in E.14.
E.14 classifies SPD as shared while PRC is position-scaled; CFB26 OOP vectors show large position penalties with ratings fixed.
Box Specialist, Hybrid, Zone/Field/Bump archetypes preserve visibly different tackling/coverage tradeoffs at comparable OVR.

CFB26 fixed-vector Speed Rusher OOP repeats across players: Jimmori Robinson 90 EDGE -> 90 DT but 88 SAM/WILL; R Mason Thomas 95 EDGE -> 95 DT but 93 SAM/WILL; Patrick Payton 92 EDGE -> 91 DT and 88 SAM/WILL; Jason Taylor 98 REDG -> 96 LEDG/DT and 94 SAM/WILL.
Some vectors tie EDGE/DT, others lose 1-2 OVR at DT or opposite edge; equivalence is item/component dependent.
E.14: BSH and FMV are position-scaled; SPD is shared; PMV remains confounded. CFB26 OOP deltas reproduce edge > off-ball valuation on fixed vectors.
Speed Rusher and Pure Power profiles emphasize different rush/strength components; CFB27 DT OOP varies by vector (e.g. 84 DT -> 83 EDGE, while 70 DT can -> 71 EDGE).
CFB26 Pocket Passer and Dual Threat trajectories retain different mobility/playmaking slack.
CFB26 elite examples reach 97-99 OVR with PAC 87-91.
Passing ratings remain central in both Pocket Passer and Dual Threat while SPD/RUN valuation differs by archetype.

global_architecture_conclusion: D is the strongest working description for OL, TE, Secondary, and Front Seven: reusable football components with both position and archetype valuation layers. QB currently supports at least an archetype layer but position layering is not applicable within native QB.
models_no_longer_worth_pursuing: historical Madden Center absolute calibration transferred unchanged to CFB27
next_highest_value_experiment: Freeze the existing CFB27 TE archetype ranking candidates and blind-score a materially larger CFB26 sample separately for Gritty Possession, Vertical Threat, Physical Route Runner, and Pure Blocker; measure exact OVR, MAE, within-one, residual-by-OVR and rank accuracy without refitting. This directly tests coefficient portability and can promote or kill the most mature family before broader refits.
